description.purpose: The seed hive of never-forgets. It draws NO edge: the agent and every lane of this colony arrive later, from templates, through grow.json. What is checked in beside it is only the part a template library cannot ship for you -- the memory this colony keeps and the lane that imports a past into it.
description.use_when: As the --root of a colony whose agent is grown rather than checked in.
description.not_in_scope: No door, no agent, no session, no drain, no terminal: none of that is written here, all of it is instantiated.
